claims.reason: A new Gemini Pro released in October would very likely debut at or above the current Coding leader. Google's Pro releases have repeatedly taken #1 on Arena at debut by a margin of tens of points. So a world where the Coding top score never reaches 1560 is very hard to square with a new Gemini Pro having shipped by Nov 1. If C1 fails, the most coherent explanation is that no such release happened in that window.
